paper_title: Axion dark matter search from terrestrial magnetic fields at extremely low frequencies
notes: Paper presents a NEW measured exclusion limit on axion-photon coupling from terrestrial magnetic field observations at extremely low frequencies (0.3–30 Hz). The primary result is a 95% CL upper bound of g_agamma ≲ 4×10^-13 GeV^-1 around axion mass m_a ≈ 3×10^-14 eV, improving CAST constraints by ~2 orders of magnitude. The limit is mass-dependent across the range 1×10^-15 eV to 1×10^-13 eV, with tightest constraint near the Schumann resonance peak at ~7.8 Hz (m_a ~ 3×10^-14 eV). Data extracted from abstract and Fig. 6. The paper also reports 65 persistent signal candidates with SNR > 3, but these are not confirmed detections. Local DM density of ρ_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3 is assumed in theoretical predictions (Eq. 9, Fig. 1).
